purpose: dual-netspeed 第一次實跑的 A 段 (design.md 第7節「第一次實跑要拆成三段」表): both instances launch and log in, then BOTH close again -- this segment self-terminates, it must not leave either process running for a later B/C run, since docs/reference/unattended-policy.md's 'remote presence' rule treats each segment as its own independent unattended run. Covers launch_client/login_as/focus_client(already tested elsewhere)/close_client only -- no room, no battle. host (copy install MetalRage2, account mrotesthost, patched IpDrv.dll MaxClientRate/MaxInternetClientRate=100000) and joiner (main install MetalRage, account mrotest) are the same 'clients' table as dual-netspeed.json/-b/-c. Success = result PASS: both logins land on the lobby screen (login_as's own screen=lobby check) and both close_client steps report the process gone. If it halts, look first at whichever login_as step failed (screenshot + session-log CQ_LOGIN_WASABII pkt in its detail) -- that is almost always either a stale login screen state or the account not being in the whitelist yet.
